verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several APIs (Alerts, Case, case listing, case import, filing), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404. API descriptions and an llms.txt help index are adjacent material, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
